title: Bali Family Holiday with Flights and Safari
alt: Elephants at Bali Safari and Marine Park
transport: Return flights, private transfers and guided tours

stops.name: Kuta
stops.subtitle: Kuta to Bedugul and the safari park
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Surf style hotel five minutes from Kuta beach

activities.name: Bedugul lakes and Tanah Lot
activities.description: The Handara gate, the lake temple of Ulun Danu Beratan and a hill waterfall, finishing at the sea temple of Tanah Lot for sunset.

activities.name: Bali Safari and Marine Park
activities.description: A safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures, the elephant and bird shows, and the water park included in the ticket.

program.name: Kuta
program.description: Three nights on the coast to open the holiday, with a full day up to the Bedugul lakes and a safari park day the children will like.

stops.name: Ubud
stops.subtitle: Ubud to Kintamani
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Garden resort a short walk from the Ubud market

activities.name: Kintamani with the jungle swing
activities.description: Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani, the crater lake view, Tegenungan waterfall, the Tegalalang terraces and the jungle swing.

program.name: Ubud
program.description: Two nights inland to finish, with a free afternoon in town and a full day through the coffee country up to the Kintamani crater.

1: Flight from Delhi to Denpasar, included in your package
Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your hotel
Check in at your Kuta hotel near the beach
Rest of the day free on the south coast
2: Breakfast, then a full day north to the lake country
The Handara gate and Ulun Danu Beratan temple
A hill waterfall in the afternoon
Sunset at Tanah Lot, the sea temple on the rocks
3: Breakfast, then a full day at Bali Safari and Marine Park
Safari ride through the African and Indian enclosures
Elephant and bird shows, then the water park
Back at the hotel in the evening
4: Breakfast and check out, then private transfer up to Ubud
Check in at your garden resort near the market
Afternoon free in the town lanes
Optional: the Monkey Forest or the art market
5: Breakfast, then a full day out with your own car and guide
Coffee plantation tasting on the climb to Kintamani
Tegenungan waterfall and the Tegalalang rice terraces
A turn on the jungle swing above the valley
6: Breakfast at the resort and check out
Private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport for your return flight

expert.name: Putu
expert.quote: Flights, a safari day and a free afternoon in Ubud. For a family of four this is the simplest Bali week to book.
expert.tip: Bali Safari takes a full day, so carry swimwear for the water park and book the elephant show slot in the morning. Ubud at the end keeps the last two days slow.

summary: Six days with return flights from Delhi: three nights in Kuta with the Bedugul lakes, sunset at Tanah Lot and a full day at Bali Safari, then two nights in Ubud with a coffee plantation day up to the Kintamani crater.
included: Included: return flights from Delhi; 5 nights with daily breakfast; private airport and inter city transfers; full day Bedugul tour with Tanah Lot; Bali Safari and Marine Park tickets; Kintamani and jungle swing tour.
not_included: Not included: Indonesia visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
